pages.text: Today they would cook thin, round crêpes. Mom poured flour and milk into a big bowl.
"I'll stir the batter! Nice and smooth." Mumu took a wooden spoon.
Mumu held out the spoon, and Dodo took it. "Stir fast to get rid of lumps. I know! Like a storm!"
Batter flew everywhere! White spots covered Dodo's face.
"This was... making freckles." With her spotted face, Dodo grinned.
Inside the bowl, the lumps were still there.
Mumu stirred slowly in circles. One by one, the lumps loosened.
The batter became smooth as silk. "All ready!"
Mom set the first golden crêpe on a plate. As the three shared it, spotted Dodo laughed the loudest. "Crêpes from the freckled cook's kitchen!"
